whole_command_resource_scope: includes cargo startup, test setup, warmup, assertions, all native returns and output/journal writes; compilation if any must be disclosed; not per-stage CPU or ordinary-binary performance
maximum_rss_scope: Linux RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum in KiB; not a simultaneous aggregate of all process memory
profile: unchanged repository test package profiles (Node opt3, debug assertions and overflow checks enabled), all features, locked/offline, build jobs1; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 as in the original required CI workflow
sample_storage: original overlay filesystem; no tmpfs database substitution
prior_observer_unavailable: GNU /usr/bin/time does not exist; no measurement command was started
source_checkpoint_change: Native regression test import corrected and its current source pin refreshed; production parser, matrix, workload and registered decision rule unchanged
earlier_build_attempts: No timing samples or native Node test returns were produced by the failed local default-incremental builds; their failures stay separately recorded
